content: पुरुषः [पुरि देहे शेते शी-ड पृषो˚ <ls>Tv.</ls>; पुर्-अग्रगमने कुषन् <ls>Uṇ. 4. 74</ls>] .²1 A male being, man; अर्थतः पुरुषो नारी या नारी सार्थतः पुमान् <ls>Mk. 3. 27</ls>; <ls>Ms. 1. 32</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">7. 17</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">9. 2</ls>; <ls>R. 2. 41</ls>. .²2 Men, mankind. .²3 A member or representative of a generation. .²4 An officer, functionary, agent, attendant, servant. .²5 The height or measure of a man (considered as a measure of length); द्वौ पुरुषौ प्रमाणमस्य सा द्विपुरुषा-षी परिखा <ls>Sk.</ls> .²6 The Soul; द्वाविमौ पुरुषौ लोके क्षरश्चाक्षर एव च <ls>Bg. 15. 16</ls> <ab>&c.</ab> .²7 The Supreme Being, God (soul of the universe); पुरातनं त्वां पुरुषं पुराविदः (विदुः) <ls>Śi. 1. 33</ls>; <ls>R. 13. 6</ls>. .²8 A person (in grammar); प्रथमपुरुषः the third person, मध्यमपुरुषः the second person, and उत्तमपुरुषः the first person, (this is the strict order in <ls>Sk.</ls>). .²9 The pupil of the eye. .²10 (In <ab>Sāṅ. phil.</ab>) The soul (<ab>opp.</ab> प्रकृति); according to the Sāṅkhyas it is neither a production nor productive; it is passive and a looker-on of the Prakṛti; <ab>cf.</ab> त्वामामनन्ति प्रकृतिं पुरुषार्थप्रवर्तिनीम् <ls>Ku. 2. 13</ls> and the word सांख्य also. .²11 The soul, the original source of the universe (described in the पुरुषसूक्त); सहस्रशीर्षः पुरुषः सहस्राक्षः सहस्रपात् <ab>&c.</ab> .²12 The Punnāga tree. .²13 <ab>N.</ab> of the first, third, fifth, seventh, ninth, and eleventh signs of the zodiac. .²14 The seven divine or active principles of which the universe was formed; तेषामिदं तु सप्तानां पुरुषाणां महौजसाम् <ls>Ms. 1. 19</ls>. .{@-षी@} A woman. .{@-षम्@} An epithet of the mountain Meru.
